notes: The variant unit WLC.PSA.148.2.v001 is marked compatible and carries no fallback exclusion, so rule 53 does not arise.
No vocative ye is written in this verse; the ye of each colon stands beside its imperative and realizes that verb's own person and number under rule 17.
The ASV writes no of between the quantifier and the noun it stands on, so each `כֹּל` keeps only its own all and rule 19's chain relation has nothing to place.
